pages.behavior: Aggressive, hunts players & livestock; $(o)ignores crouching players
pages.taming: Feed 4* $(treat1) whilst it is basking on land

pages.text: Blurpums can often be seen basking with their mouths wide open next to the water's edge

Blurpums can be ridden when tamed. Upon receiving damage, blurpums will occasionally release a poisonous gas in response.$(br2)Blurpums come in three biome-dependent variants: Freshwater, cold, and coastal. Freshwater blurpums deal more damage and have the most lethal poison, but are the slowest; cold blurpums have more health and regeneration, and their poison gas also freezes, but deal the least damage; coastal blurpums are faster and their posion replenishes quicker, but have less health
